steps.title: From one sentence to a server in three steps
steps.subtitle: No templates, no copying someone else's server. Just your description and a tailored proposal.

features.title: A structure that makes sense
features.subtitle: Not just a handful of channels. Ohnivo handles the parts people forget.
features.blueprintBody: The model gets Discord conventions and your community type. The result fits you, not a generic list.
features.permissionsBody: The whitelist is enforced in code. The AI never gets Administrator, Manage Guild or webhooks.
features.previewBody: Rename, delete or reorder anything. Then write “add ticketing” and let the blueprint be rewritten.
features.applyBody: The bot creates roles, categories and channels in a safe order. You watch a live checklist.
features.modulesBody: Welcome, moderation, tickets, reaction roles and levels. Enable them without extra credits.
features.creditsBody: Every AI action has a clear price. The ledger is append-only, so you always see where credits went.

faq.title: Before you dive in
faq.q1: Do I have to give the bot Administrator?
faq.a1: No. The bot needs only Manage Channels, Manage Roles, View Channels, Send Messages and Manage Messages. Nothing more.
faq.a2: No. Ohnivo never deletes existing channels or roles without a second explicit confirmation. You can build next to your structure or merge into it.
faq.q3: What if I don't like the proposal?
faq.a3: Edit it in the preview, regenerate, or send another instruction. Credits are charged only for real AI calls.
faq.a4: Generation, refinement, apply and graphics each have a price. Credits are added every billing period and every movement is in the ledger.
faq.a5: Yes. The web app has a Czech/English switch and the bot sends welcomes in the server language.
faq.a6: A standalone Docker service that talks to the web app through a Supabase queue. The web runs on Vercel, the bot does not.

ready.faqTitle: What if I don't like it?
ready.faq1a: Yes. Cancel during the countdown without spending credits. A running job can finish; existing channels are not deleted.
ready.faq2q: Will I lose my current server?
ready.faq2a: No. The bot only adds. Deleting existing objects requires a separate explicit confirmation that this step does not have.
ready.modeTitle: How to handle the existing structure
ready.modeMergeBody: Categories and channels with the same name are reused instead of created again.
ready.modeAppendBody: New categories and channels are created next to existing ones, even with the same name.
ready.modeHint: In both modes, nothing existing is deleted.
ready.stepsNote: After starting you will see a live checklist. The bot creates roles, categories, channels, permissions and finally posts the welcome.
